candidates.snippet: 1901: Fleming's early education - Attended St. Mary's Hospital Medical School, London, beginning his medical studies. 1928: Discovery of Penicillin - Observed the antibacterial properties of Penicillium notatum, leading to the discovery of penicillin. 1945: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine - Awarded the Nobel Prize for his discovery of penicillin. 1955: Death of Alexander Fleming - Died in London, England, leaving a lasting legacy in medical science.
